title: Auditing and Adapting kNNGuard for Long-Context Prompts
abstract: arXiv:2611.27084v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training-free activation guardrails such as kNNGuard score prompts by comparing last-token LLM hidden states (the Layer Ensemble branch, kNNGuard LE) and sentence embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, Embedding-kNN) against a small reference bank (50 examples per class), combining the two branches into a Fused Ensemble (kNNGuard FE). While effective on short inputs (up to 256 tokens), standard kNNGuard degrades substantially on long inputs (over 1000 tokens): averaged across Qwen3.5-4B and Gemma-4-E4B-it, kNNGuard LE AUROC drops from 0.742 (0.777 and 0.706) to 0.554 (0.587 and 0.521) on Content Harm Moderation (Aegis-2.0), and from 0.994 (0.995 and 0.992) to 0.556 (0.598 and 0.513) on RAG Hallucination Detection (HaluBench). We trace this degradation to three causes: (1) hidden-state drift as sequence length increases, (2) hard 256-token truncation in MiniLM, and (3) signal dilution when a long document is compressed into a single final-token ve

translated_title: 审计并适配kNNGuard以应对长上下文提示
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.27084v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：诸如kNNGuard这类无需训练的激活防护栏，通过将大语言模型最后一个token的隐藏状态（层集成分支，kNNGuard LE）以及句子嵌入（all-MiniLM-L6-v2，Embedding-kNN）与一个小型参考库（每类50个样本）进行对比来对提示进行评分，并将这两个分支组合成融合集成方法（kNNGuard FE）。虽然在短输入（最多256个token）上表现有效，但标准kNNGuard在长输入（超过1000个token）上性能大幅下降：在Qwen3.5-4B和Gemma-4-E4B-it两个模型上取平均，kNNGuard LE的AUROC在内容有害性审核任务（Aegis-2.0）上从0.742（0.777和0.706）降至0.554（0.587和0.521），在RAG幻觉检测任务（HaluBench）上从0.994（0.995和0.992）降至0.556（0.598和0.513）。我们将这种性能退化归因于三个原因：(1) 随着序列长度增加，隐藏状态发生漂移；(2) MiniLM存在硬性的256个token截断限制；(3) 当长文档被压缩为单个最终token向量时，关键信号被稀释。
tldr: 本文审计了无需训练的防护栏kNNGuard在长上下文提示上的性能退化现象，发现其在长输入上AUROC大幅下降，并将退化归因于隐藏状态漂移、MiniLM的256 token硬截断以及长文档压缩为单一最终token向量导致的信号稀释这三个原因。
en_tdlr: This paper audits kNNGuard's substantial performance degradation on long-context prompts, tracing it to three causes: hidden-state drift with increasing sequence length, MiniLM's hard 256-token truncation, and signal dilution when long documents are compressed into a single final-token vector.
